name: section
useFor: Use SiteSection for content layout, SectionHeading for the title and description, and Eyebrow for an optional label. Choose white, paper or blue backgrounds as needed.
constraints: Two blue sections in a row
Left-aligned section titles over centered content
A ground change without a band divider
documentation:
`SiteSection` props: `ground` ("white" | "paper" | "blue"), `contained` (default true: the 1200px column),
`innerClassName`, plus section props. `SectionHeading` props: `title`, `description`, `eyebrow`, `as` ("h1" | "h2" |
"h3", default h2), `align` ("center" | "start"). `Eyebrow` takes paragraph props.
title: Section
description: Page section, section heading and optional label.
